metadata.title: [Bug] Parameters turn into Tensors after load

trigger_conditions.condition: Serializing and deserializing objects containing framework-specific state, such as torch.nn.Parameter attributes, where the restored object loses its original semantic type or state information.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Saving a torch.nn.Module that has torch.nn.Parameter attributes (including nested module parameters) with torch.save, then loading it with torch.load. The loaded module retains the attribute but its type changes from torch.nn.Parameter to torch.Tensor.

failure_behavior.description: Saving a torch.nn.Module that has torch.nn.Parameter attributes (including nested module parameters) with torch.save, then loading it with torch.load. The loaded module retains the attribute but its type changes from torch.nn.Parameter to torch.Tensor.
